scope: Practical review of current standalone baseline-only controller, its immutable prospective plan and the imported helper interfaces. No SSH, model execution, CUDA allocation or training performed by this review.

checks_executed.check: Python AST syntax parse without bytecode output

narrow_repair.problem: The previous all-key comparison included status. The actual lambda0 producer intentionally changes PROTOCOL status formal_control_authorized_recipe to CONTROL_COMPLETE status completed, so valid terminal completion was rejected.
narrow_repair.change: Require both exact expected statuses separately and compare every remaining protocol key unchanged.

reviewed_implemented_guards: Only the original OLD U Python environment and already fixed U final200 are accepted; no GTA or optimizer is launched.
Eight manifest fold0 IDs must match the plan in order and be disjoint from trained28 and internal4.
Actual lambda0 terminal closure, released child/resource status, POSTFIT20/80, payload hashes and source identity are required before inference.
Separate owner mutex, both OLD host stage locks and two idle GPU snapshots precede an owned evaluator process group.
Timeout and ordinary cancellation clean only the owned evaluator before releasing locks; fresh-only execution performs no retry or restart.
Original-grid predictions are checked for all eight; Dice and pooled physical-mm ASSD are recomputed from saved binary pixels and original GT.
Undefined distances remain null and prevent a complete-cohort ASSD mean; overall and subgroup summaries are checked.
Before/after source, checkpoint, accepted U evidence, CT and GT bytes are checked.
Detailed logs, metrics, predictions and errors remain in restrictive quarantine; public STATUS carries lifecycle/counts only and cannot unseal automatically.
remaining_deployment_gate: Exercise the corrected dependency_ready production function against the actual completed lambda0 evidence, then record an explicit ROOT deployment decision. The actual lambda0 capture was not yet available to this review.
limits: No claim of actual baseline-only deployment, inference completion or performance is made.
Plan/syntax success does not prove actual terminal dependency compatibility or server runtime readiness.
SIGKILL or machine power-loss orphan handling is not established by the ordinary signal/timeout cleanup code.
related_issue_reported_separately: The completed-control collector had the same terminal status comparison issue. A separate repair agent owns collector and adapter changes; this review did not edit either helper.
